Controls.Brush: Brush: draw near a wall of the map and it snaps to it. Enter or click: create, Escape: cancel.
Controls.Weld: Weld: closes small gaps between the selected walls (or the whole scene).

Enabled.Name: Auto-linked walls
Enabled.Hint: Snaps walls together while drawing and keeps joints when you move them. Also toggled with the chain button in the wall tools. Per browser.

SnapDistance.Name: Snap distance (screen px)
SnapDistance.Hint: An endpoint dropped closer than this to another wall sticks to it: to its endpoint first, otherwise to its middle. Measured on screen: same feel at any zoom. Also used to weld brush walls. 0 disables snapping.

MoveJoints.Name: Joints follow
MoveJoints.Hint: When you move an endpoint or a wall, the walls that shared that point follow it instead of coming apart.

AutoSplit.Name: T-junction split
AutoSplit.Hint: A wall whose endpoint lands in the middle of another splits it in two, so each piece stays linked.

SkipDoors.Name: Never split doors
SkipDoors.Hint: A door touched in its middle stays whole.

BrushRadius.Name: Brush: search distance (screen px)
BrushRadius.Hint: How far the brush looks for a wall around the stroke, measured on screen: zooming in makes the search finer. Per browser.

BrushDetail.Name: Brush: precision (screen px)
BrushDetail.Hint: Largest gap between the created walls and the traced outline, measured on screen. Lower: more detail (and more walls). Per browser.

BrushWallType.Name: Brush: wall type
BrushWallType.Hint: Type of the walls the brush creates. Passable: tokens walk through, but sight and light are blocked. Invisible: blocks movement, not sight. Also changed in the brush panel. Per browser.

GrilleRender.Name: Grate rendering
GrilleRender.Hint: Projected: the grate's shadow is painted on the floor from the light and grate heights (grid pattern, penumbra). Rays: small hidden walls that cut light into rays (2.1 rendering, lighter).

GrilleShadow.Name: Grate shadow strength
GrilleShadow.Hint: Strength of a grate's projected shadow at night. A firelight shadow is not black: the room still lights it a little. 1: pitch black. Bars in front of a PC's eyes stay pitch black.

SelectConnected.Name: Select linked walls
SelectConnected.Hint: Selects every wall linked to the hovered (or selected) wall.

Brush.NoBackground: The brush reads the scene's background image, and this scene has none.
Brush.NoWall: No clear wall here: the preview keeps your stroke as drawn. Enter to create it anyway, Escape to cancel.
Brush.ReadError: The brush could not read the background image ({message}). If it is hosted on another site, copy it into Foundry's data.
Brush.KnobHint: Precision: mouse wheel, drag up or down, or arrow keys

Pattern.Label: Pattern
Pattern.Hint: Light passes between the bars and casts striped shadows. The wall lets light through: its hidden bars cut it.
Pattern.DensityHint: 1: original pattern. 2: bars twice as far apart. 0.5: twice as tight.
Pattern.KnobHint: Bar spacing: mouse wheel, drag up or down, or arrow keys
Pattern.HeightsHint: In grid units. Bottom at 0: portcullis or cell bars. Higher bottom: window with a solid wall below. Above the top, solid wall. Used by projected rendering.

Light.HeightHint: In grid units, from the floor. The higher it is, the farther a grate's shadow bands fall.
Light.FlameHint: Radius in grid units. Candle ≈ 0.02, torch ≈ 0.06, brazier ≈ 0.3, campfire ≈ 0.6. The larger, the softer a grate's shadow.
Light.TokenHint: A carried light's height follows the token's size (hand height).
